acceptance_protocol.cpu_test: Four-request paired measured round: Git/npm total process plus waited-child CPU seconds minus jobs2 total CPU seconds. Lower CPU supported only if lower interval endpoint is > 0.
acceptance_protocol.default_comparison: Separate paired jobs4-minus-jobs2 lifecycle seconds and CPU seconds. This is not the >=2x baseline test.
acceptance_protocol.elapsed_test: Four-request paired measured round: Git/npm full lifecycle seconds minus 2 * jobs2 full lifecycle seconds. Target supported only if the lower interval endpoint is >= 0.
acceptance_protocol.failures: Stop and retain partial rows/owned storage on any failure. No automatic restart, rerun or second configuration.
acceptance_protocol.fixture_mode: All timing methods inherit umask 077, matching the later fresh memory coordinators. Canonical workload content/executable-mode identity must match across protocols; seed IDs/commit timestamps remain separately recorded.
acceptance_protocol.interval: With seven independent paired rounds, [minimum, maximum] is a 98.4375% distribution-free median interval. Independence is an assumption; method order and timestamps are retained for drift review.
acceptance_protocol.memory: This timing run does not measure memory. A separate memory report is required; no all-resource win is inferred.
acceptance_protocol.public_coverage: Preserves the existing public folder timing matrix: one and four requests, Git/npm and default jobs4. Does not supply current scan, file-command, image or memory results.
acceptance_protocol.rounds: One retained warmup round plus seven measured rounds; each round has a one-request baseline/default pair and four-request baseline/default/jobs2 triple. Blocks alternate [1,4] then [4,1]; methods shuffle within each block with fixed seed 20261006. All 40 batches (35 measured, 5 warmup) are retained.
acceptance_protocol.scope: Current 0.6.2 public folder timings at one and four workspaces plus one final four-request jobs2 screen. No jobs1, serialization or setting sweep.
acceptance_protocol.version_comparison: The new ACL and GC reliability checks apply to both folder configurations; no causal speedup is attributed against historical 0.6.1 timings. Current default rows are published independently of whether jobs2 wins.

canonical_fixture_identity.digest_definition: Existing harness SHA256 of sorted relative path, content/symlink-target SHA256 and executable bits; .git excluded

configurations.stallionfs_folder: Store.create jobs=4 per request; one or four requests
configurations.stallionfs_folder_jobs2: Store.create jobs=2 per request; four requests only
configurations.worktree_install: Git worktree plus offline npm ci per request; serialized registration

correctness: Every measured and warmup workspace matched full content/executable-mode digest (excluding Git metadata) and passed fixture smoke test
cpu_timing: Process CPU including worker threads plus waited child-process CPU, summed over the same ready/remove/reclaim phases as wall time. Validation is excluded.
gc_configuration: Both folder methods use unchanged Store.move and Store.gc jobs=4
runtime_note: Fresh 0.6.2 reliability build; jobs2 and jobs4 differ only in create worker count. Historical 0.6.1 timings are not a causal version comparison.
storage_note: Seed content bytes include Git; shared APFS clone blocks are not inferred from logical file sizes.
timing: API wall time, warm filesystem cache, no cache flushing; setup downloads excluded
worktree_coordination: Only Git registration is serialized; installation and filesystem deletion run in parallel. One final Git prune is included in removal timing.

comparison_method.baseline: Git worktree creation plus offline npm ci, completed removal and final Git prune.
comparison_method.default: Prepared folder backend with create jobs=4; one or four concurrent requests. Move and GC remain jobs=4.
comparison_method.experiment: Four concurrent requests with create jobs=2. All eight experiment rows are retained; this is not the default.
comparison_method.samples: Seven measured rounds plus one retained warmup for each of five configurations; all 40 rows preserved.
comparison_method.cpu: Coordinator process CPU including native threads plus waited child CPU over matching ready/remove/reclaim phases; validation excluded.
comparison_method.cpu_utilization: Median/min/max of per-batch total_cpu_s/total_s, not a ratio of medians. Average occupied cores are not peak or machine-wide utilization.
comparison_method.formulas: Current default comparison: candidate median minus Git/npm median; ratio Git/npm divided by candidate. Negative differences and ratios above one favor candidate.
comparison_method.paired_intervals: Jobs2 intervals use seven within-round differences; min/max has 98.4375% coverage for the median only under independent rounds. Host drift may correlate rounds; no sample exclusions or correction applied.
comparison_method.memory: No memory measurement in this timing report. Separate memory results must validate the canonical fixture digest; no memory advantage is inferred here.
comparison_method.units: Seconds for wall/CPU; average CPU cores dimensionless. Cold preparation remains separate from ready/lifecycle timing.

host_drift_context.note: Substantial elapsed-time variation occurred across rounds, including in the contemporaneous Git/npm control. Timestamps and shuffled order are retained. These data do not isolate its cause or establish a causal comparison against earlier releases.

export_provenance.preservation: Every raw row and runtime/source hash is unchanged. Only the private fixture path label and memory-scope note are replaced. No measured rows, warmups, losses or experiment controls are omitted.
